items.title_zh: 百度开源发布文心 Unlimited OCR 2 文档解析模型，支持“无限”页数
items.title_en: Baidu Open-Sources Wenxin Unlimited OCR 2 for 'Unlimited' Document Parsing
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，百度 (Baidu) 本月 27 日正式发布并开源文心 Unlimited OCR 2 模型。其将文档解析的上限从数十页推向“无限”， 能一次性解析累计超过 3,600 页的《哈利 · 波特》全系列 7 部作品 。 Unlimited OCR 2 原生支持版面要素切分识别 ， 具备跨页文案合并、表格识别合并能力 ，在同样算力下处理更多、更快、更省。 百度表示，文心 Unlimited OCR 2 在面向多页文档解析的 MPDocBench 基准测试上得到 84.6 分、在专门评估百页级超长文档解析能力的 MarathonDocBench 基准测试上得到 77.1 分， 均实现端到端性能 SOTA 。 参考 https://ai.baidu.com/support/news ?action=detail&id=3290
items.summary_en: Baidu released and open-sourced Wenxin Unlimited OCR 2 on Oct. 27, claiming it can parse documents with effectively “unlimited” pages, including all seven Harry Potter books totaling over 3,600 pages. The model natively supports layout element segmentation, cross-page text merging and table recognition merging, while handling more documents faster and more efficiently at the same compute. Baidu reports scores of 84.6 on MPDocBench and 77.1 on MarathonDocBench, claiming end-to-end SOTA performance.
items.why_zh: 超长文档解析是OCR落地的关键场景，开源有望降低长文档数字化与信息抽取的门槛。
items.why_en: Ultra-long document parsing is a key OCR use case, and open-sourcing could lower the barrier to digitizing and extracting information from lengthy documents.

items.title_zh: 告别知识截止日：谷歌让 AI 学会“睡觉”，边用边学还不忘旧知识
items.title_en: Google proposes a 'Sleep Framework' to let LLMs learn continuously without catastrophic forgetting
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，谷歌研究团队于 10 月 27 日发布博文， 介绍一项名为“睡眠框架”（Sleep Framework）的持续学习研究成果，试图解决大语言模型发布后知识固化、难以吸收新信息的难题。 该研究已于 10 月 27 日由 Google Research 公开，相关论文题为《Language Models Need Sleep: Learning to Self-Modify and Consolidate Memories》。 谷歌指出在通常情况下，当前主流大模型在完成预训练后便进入相对静态的部署状态，其知识存在“截止日期”；若依赖上下文学习，新信息又会随会话结束而丢失。若直接用新数据反复微调，则容易引发“灾难性遗忘”，而模型学会新知识后，原有能力显著下降。 谷歌的方案借鉴人类睡眠中的记忆巩固机制，将模型运行划分为“清醒阶段”和“睡眠阶段”。清醒时，模型接收并处理输入，将信息暂存于短期记忆；进入睡眠阶段后，模型暂停处理新输入，转而进行记忆整合与自我改进。 具体而言，“记忆巩固”环节通过参数扩展、混合专家记忆块和知识蒸馏，把脆弱的短期上下文信息写入长期参数，同时避免覆盖既有知识；“做梦”环节则让模型生成并筛选合成训练样本，借助强化学习反复练习，以提升推理与泛化能力。 实验显示，该框架在持续翻译、长上下文理解、事实知识吸收和数学推理等任务中优于多种基线方法：…
items.summary_en: Google Research has introduced a 'Sleep Framework' for continual learning in large language models. It separates wake and sleep phases: during wake the model processes inputs into short-term memory, while during sleep it consolidates memories via parameter expansion, mixture-of-experts memory blocks and distillation, and generates synthetic training samples for reinforcement learning. Experiments reportedly outperform baselines on continual translation, long-context understanding, fact absorption and math reasoning.
items.why_zh: 若该方法成熟，大模型有望摆脱知识截止日期，在不重训、不遗忘旧能力的情况下持续更新。
items.why_en: If validated, it could free LLMs from fixed knowledge cutoffs and enable continuous updates without full retraining or forgetting.

items.title_zh: OPPO Reno17 系列手机、Watch 5 手表、Pad Air6 平板开启预约
items.title_en: OPPO Reno17 Series, Watch 5 and Pad Air6 Open for Pre-orders
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，OPPO Reno17 系列手机、Watch 5 手表、Pad Air6 平板今日开启预约。 OPPO 智能生态产品总监乔家栋公布了 OPPO Pad Air6 平板的外观，这款平板搭载 全新 OPPO 笔记 ，并新增“一碰互传”功能。 OPPO Reno 系列产品发言人张若星透露， Reno17 系列的外观设计再次突破 ，用前沿工艺科技重新诠释灵动的生命力。 据IT之家此前报道，博主 @数码闲聊站 之前爆料了 OPPO Reno17 Pro 的部分核心配置： 6.32 英寸 1.5K 分辨率、120Hz 刷新率直屏 联发科天玑 8550 SUPER 处理器 前置摄像头 5000 万像素 后置 2 亿像素大底云台主摄、5000 万像素超广角和 5000 万像素潜望长焦 电池容量预计在 7000mAh 上下 定位“轻薄拍照小屏机”
items.summary_en: OPPO opened pre-orders on Oct 30 for its Reno17 phone series, Watch 5 and Pad Air6. The tablet adds a new OPPO Notes app and a tap-to-transfer feature, while leaked specs suggest the Reno17 Pro pairs a 6.32-inch 1.5K 120Hz display and a Dimensity 8550 SUPER chip with a 200MP gimbal main camera and a roughly 7000mAh battery.
items.why_zh: 预约开启意味着 OPPO 新一轮中高端产品周期启动，其轻薄影像定位与生态联动将直接参与国内换机市场竞争。
items.why_en: The pre-order launch marks OPPO's next premium refresh cycle, with its thin-and-light imaging pitch set to compete directly in China's handset market.

items.title_zh: Meta 悄悄推出穿搭应用 Style Sketch：AI 帮你搭衣服，还能虚拟试穿
items.title_en: Meta Quietly Launches AI Outfit App Style Sketch With Virtual Try-On
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，Meta 悄悄推出了 AI 穿搭应用 Style Sketch，用户可以借助这款软件，利用自己已有的衣物搭配出穿搭方案。这款应用可以关联 Instagram，根据用户发布过的照片生成虚拟衣橱；用户也可以手动添加衣物，方式包括现场拍照、录制短视频或者上传相册里的图片。 之后 Style Sketch 会基于衣橱里的衣物，结合用户的风格偏好，推荐穿搭组合。应用介绍写道，用户还能在“和自己身形、肤色匹配的写实虚拟模特”身上试穿这套搭配。 这款应用目前已经在印度尼西亚、新加坡和泰国上线，支持 iOS 与安卓系统。目前还不清楚 Meta 是否打算在更多地区推出 Style Sketch。 市面上已经有不少 AI 应用可以帮用户把衣橱数字化、预览新搭配，Alta 这类初创产品就是其中的代表。就连谷歌相册也提供相关工具，用户可以把衣物照片做成数字衣橱，在里面构思穿搭。 想要在已有市场里竞争，Meta 大概率不会只靠这个创意本身，而是重点依托它和 Instagram 的打通能力，很多用户早已在 Instagram 上留存了大量能够体现个人穿搭风格的影像记录。 根据应用说明，Style Sketch 不会盲目推荐搭配。用户可以选中衣橱里某一件单品，获取围绕这件单品延伸出来的全新穿搭思路。 这款应用还可以帮用户规划出行穿搭。用户输入目的地、行程时长和安排好的活动后，其…
items.summary_en: Meta has quietly released Style Sketch, an AI styling app that builds a virtual wardrobe from linked Instagram photos or user uploads and recommends outfits, including virtual try-ons on realistic models matched to the user's body and skin tone. It is live in Indonesia, Singapore and Thailand on iOS and Android, with no word yet on wider rollout.
items.why_zh: 该应用把 Instagram 上沉淀的海量个人穿搭影像转化为 AI 消费级入口，是 Meta 在生成式 AI 应用层一次低调但具战略意味的试探。
items.why_en: The app turns Instagram's trove of personal style imagery into a consumer AI entry point, making it a quiet but strategic test of Meta's generative-AI product strategy.

items.title_zh: 新研究称 AI 模型使用成本受不同语种影响，Token 消耗量最高可相差 17 倍
items.title_en: Study Finds Token Use Across Languages Can Differ by Up to 17x, a Hidden 'Tokenizer Tax'
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，使用人数较少的语言的用户，使用 AI 服务时，可能需要支付比英语及其他主流语言用户更高的费用。 当地时间 28 日，据外媒 Rest of World 报道，人工智能语言公平研究联盟上月发布的一项研究发现，AI 模型处理不同语言时，消耗的 Token（词元）数量 可能相差悬殊 。 Token 是 AI 模型处理文本等数据的基本单位，由分词器将文本、图像或音频拆分而成。研究人员将不同语言因此产生的额外成本称为 隐性的“分词器税” ，网络内容较少的语言尤其容易受到影响。 研究发现，即使是互联网上最常用的 20 种语言，Token 消耗量也存在明显差异， 最高是最低的 1.5 至 5 倍 。如果将测试范围扩大到 200 种语言，差距还会进一步扩大。在其中一个 AI 模型中， 不同语言的 Token 消耗量最多相差 17 倍 。 研究报告指出，班加罗尔的一家初创企业每次向 AI 输入指令、获取回答时，都可能比奥斯汀的竞争对手付出更高的成本。“分词器税”带来的问题还不只是费用上涨。消耗的 Token 越多，AI 响应就越慢，能够有效处理的上下文内容也越少。 计算资源和网络条件本就有限的地区受到的影响尤其严重。 分词处理上的不平等，也限制了人们参与 AI 经济的机会 。 印度首家专注 AI 投资的风险投资基金 Activate AI 联合创始人普拉蒂尤什 ·…
items.summary_en: Research from the AI language-equity coalition found that token consumption varies sharply by language, up to 17x in one model, creating a hidden 'tokenizer tax' that raises costs, slows responses and shrinks usable context, especially for under-resourced languages. Even among the 20 most common internet languages, usage differs by 1.5 to 5 times.
items.why_zh: 它揭示 AI 的成本与体验不平等被编码进了分词器这一底层环节，为语言公平和 AI 普惠讨论提供了少见的可量化证据。
items.why_en: It shows that AI cost and quality inequities are baked into tokenization itself, offering rare quantifiable evidence for the language-fairness debate.

items.title_zh: 重新审视 LLM 因果推理评测：CLadder 程序化生成基准的局限
items.title_en: Evaluating Causal Reasoning in LLMs: A Case Study in the Challenges of Procedural Generation
items.summary_zh: 一篇新 arXiv 论文以 CLadder 为案例，讨论用程序化生成方式评测大模型形式化因果推理能力时存在的问题。CLadder 于 2023 年发布，是评估 LLM 形式因果推理最常用的基准之一，此前的实验似乎显示模型在很大比例的生成了的样本上能够完成因果推理。作者在文中重新检视这些结果，分析这类程序化生成的测试数据在多大程度上真正衡量了因果推理本身。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.38100v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) appear to represent and reason about a large range of phenomena. In particular, recent studies have examined whether LLMs can accurately reason about causation. One of the most commonly used benchmarks for evaluating formal causal reasoning in LLMs is CLadder, a framework for procedural generation of benchmark data sets that was released in 2023. Experiments with CLadder appear to indicate that LLMs can perform formal causal reasoning in a large percentage of generated examples. In this paper, we examine what can be r…
items.why_zh: 如果基准本身存在生成偏差，模型在因果推理上的高分可能被高估，直接影响对 LLM 推理能力的判断。
items.why_en: If the benchmark itself carries generation artifacts, LLM scores on causal reasoning may be inflated, skewing assessments of model capability.

items.title_zh: 不只是编造：AI 研究智能体论文中的数字错配问题
items.title_en: Beyond fabrication: Misattributed numbers in papers written by AI research agents
items.summary_zh: 一篇新 arXiv 论文关注 AI 智能体撰写的研究论文中数字主张的可验证性问题。作者指出，近期基准显示许多由智能体撰写的论文未能通过完整性检查，但这些判定往往由单个 LLM 评审给出，只说明失败而不解释失败的性质；现有检查要么验证论文内部一致性，要么只确认某个数值是否曾出现在智能体输出中。研究重新分析了某公开 AI 研究智能体基准发布的全部 540 条判定，涉及九个智能体和十五个开放研究问题，聚焦数字被错误归属的问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.38691v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Verifying numerical claims in research written by AI agents is an important but challenging problem. Recent benchmarks show that many agent-written papers fail integrity checks, but such verdicts, often produced by a single LLM judge, identify failure without explaining its nature, and existing checks either test a paper for internal consistency or test whether a reported value appears somewhere in an agent's output. We re-analyze all 540 released judgments from a recent public benchmark of AI research agents (nine agents, fifteen open research p…
items.why_zh: 随着 AI 智能体参与论文写作，仅靠单一模型评审无法定位数字错配等隐蔽错误，需要更细粒度的核查方法。
items.why_en: As AI agents help write research, single-model judging cannot catch subtle errors like misattributed numbers, pointing to a need for finer-grained verification.

items.title_zh: 混合记忆架构让长程对话智能体兼顾情节记忆与关系记忆
items.title_en: Long-Term Agent Memory through Complementary Curation and Consolidation
items.summary_zh: 一篇新的 arXiv 论文提出面向长程对话智能体的混合记忆架构：由情节记忆（记录事实与事件）和结构化关系记忆两部分组成，并配合一套保持效率的记忆整合（consolidation）机制，使智能体能够从冗长的交互历史中召回事实、事件与关系。作者在 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval-S 两个基准上进行了实证研究，发现两类记忆始终呈现互补性：同时使用二者不仅优于现有最先进的记忆框架，还取得了 90.2 的成绩（原文摘要在此处截断）。该工作为长程智能体的记忆设计提供了可复用的组合思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.39790v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-horizon dialogue agents require effective memory systems to recall facts, events, and relationships from interaction histories. In this work, we propose a hybrid-memory architecture comprising episodic memories and structured relational memories and a consolidation mechanism which preserves efficiency. We conduct an empirical study across two benchmarks: LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S. Our experiments demonstrate that the two memory types are consistently complementary, combining both outperform state-of-the-art memory frameworks and achieves 90.2…
items.why_zh: 长程对话智能体的核心瓶颈之一就是记忆，该研究证明情节记忆与关系记忆可以互补叠加，为智能体记忆系统设计提供了可直接借鉴的路线。
items.why_en: Memory is a core bottleneck for long-horizon agents, and this work shows episodic and relational memory are complementary, offering a directly reusable design pattern for agent memory systems.

items.title_zh: 新数据集 OpenConjecture：用随机抽样的数学猜想检验语言模型
items.title_en: Beyond Selected Breakthroughs: Evaluating Language Models on Randomly Sampled Mathematical Conjectures
items.summary_zh: 过去一年，前沿语言模型已能为长期悬而未决的数学猜想给出证明或反例，但只盯着这些“被选中的突破”会让人高估模型能力，也看不清达成结果所需的算力。为此，研究者构建了新数据集 OpenConjecture，从 2026 年 2 月以来发表在 arXiv 上的数学论文中收集猜想，作为开放性数学问题的来源，用随机抽样的方式评估语言模型。这一做法旨在提供更完整、更有代表性的模型能力画像，而非仅聚焦少数轰动性案例。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.40382v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The last year has seen a shift in AI-assisted mathematics, with frontier language models producing proofs of and counterexamples to long-standing open conjectures. However, studying only the current set of major breakthroughs provides an incomplete picture of LLM capabilities and the computational resources needed to achieve reported results. To address this, we introduce a new dataset, OpenConjecture, which collects conjectures from mathematics papers published on the arXiv since February 2026. We use these conjectures as a source of open mathem…
items.why_zh: 它把评测对象从少数“明星猜想”扩展到随机抽样的真实数学问题，有助于更客观地衡量 LLM 在数学研究中的实际能力与算力成本。
items.why_en: It shifts evaluation from a handful of headline conjectures to randomly sampled real mathematical problems, giving a more objective picture of LLMs' actual math capability and its compute cost.

items.title_zh: “产物蒸馏”：免训练把前沿模型能力迁移到小模型
items.title_en: Artifact Distillation: Training-Free Transfer from Frontier to Small Language Models
items.summary_zh: 缩小前沿模型与小模型差距的常见做法是蒸馏：用教师模型的输出微调学生模型，但这种方式让能力迁移依赖训练算力，且迁移的知识不透明。论文提出“产物蒸馏”（Artifact Distillation）：教师模型解题后，把解题过程外化到一个“产物库”中，学生在推理时查询该库，全程无需梯度更新。在四个 LiveBench 任务上，由 Claude Opus 4.5 编写的产物库让小模型取得了提升（原文摘要在此截断）。这一思路把能力迁移从训练阶段转移到推理阶段的检索。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.37680v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Closing the gap between frontier and smaller language models is usually approached by distillation: fine-tuning the small model (student) on a frontier model's (teacher) outputs, which binds transfer to training compute and leaves the transferred knowledge largely opaque. We propose Artifact Distillation: a teacher solves training instances and externalizes its problem-solving procedure into an artifact bank that a student queries at inference time, with no gradient updates. Across four LiveBench tasks, a bank written by Claude Opus 4.5 lets Cl…
items.why_zh: 它提出一条不依赖再训练的能力迁移路径，若能规模化，将降低小模型获得前沿能力的算力门槛并提高过程可解释性。
items.why_en: It offers a transfer route that avoids retraining, potentially lowering the compute barrier for small models to gain frontier capabilities while making the process more inspectable.

items.title_zh: 面向 LLM 对齐的排序感知差分隐私列表偏好发布
items.title_en: Rank-Aware Differentially Private Release of Listwise Preferences for LLM Alignment
items.summary_zh: 列表式偏好反馈比成对比较能为大语言模型对齐提供更丰富的监督信号，但完整排名也会泄露更多敏感的用户偏好。现有隐私保护对齐方法主要针对成对反馈，局部差分隐私（LDP）下的列表式对齐仍属空白。论文指出关键难点：完整排名空间敏感度过高，若直接套用 LDP 就需要注入过量噪声，从而抵消列表式监督带来的收益；为此作者提出排序感知的发布方法以缓解这一问题（摘要在此处截断）。该工作把隐私保护对齐从两两比较推进到完整排序场景。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.37682v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Listwise preference feedback offers richer supervision for large language model (LLMs) alignment than pairwise comparisons, but a full ranking also reveals more sensitive user preferences. Existing privacy-preserving alignment methods focus mainly on pairwise feedback, while listwise alignment under local differential privacy (LDP) remains unexplored. Extending LDP to this listwise domain raises a critical challenge: the high sensitivity of the full ranking space demands excessive noise, neutralizing the benefits of listwise supervision. To add…
items.why_zh: 随着对齐数据越来越依赖用户反馈，如何在利用列表式偏好的同时满足本地差分隐私，是隐私合规对齐必须解决的实际问题。
items.why_en: As alignment data increasingly comes from user feedback, reconciling listwise preference supervision with local differential privacy is a practical requirement for privacy-compliant alignment.

items.title_zh: “规划越多反而更糟”：世界模型中的学习型规划器研究
items.title_en: When More Planning Hurts: Learned Planners for World Models
items.summary_zh: 论文在 PushT 任务上比较了几种规划方案。作者提出的固定动作更新器仅含 1,505 个参数，却在 16 个留出场景中解出 8 个，总规划与编码耗时 59.079 秒。对比方案中，Selected Adam 解出 7 个任务、耗时 218.440 秒；改造版 iCEM 仅解出 2 个、耗时 49.309 秒；已发布的 LePlanner 解出全部 16 个任务、耗时仅 5.652 秒。作者同时说明，其动作更新器并未满足实验前固定的任务成本标准。结果提示“更多规划”并不必然带来更好表现，规划器的选择需权衡解题率与耗时。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.37891v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: On PushT, our fixed action updater (1,505 parameters) solves 8 of 16 scenes reserved from our configuration selection. The comparison planners perform as follows: Selected Adam (7 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 218.440s), adapted iCEM (2 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 49.309s), released LePlanner (16 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 5.652s). The total planning and encoding time for our action updater is 59.079s. Note that our action updater does not satisfy the task-cost criterion we fixed before ev…
items.why_zh: 它用具体数据说明规划强度与效果并非单调关系，提醒研究者在世界模型规划中重视成本与收益的权衡。
items.why_en: It shows with concrete numbers that more planning is not monotonically better, cautioning researchers to weigh cost against benefit in world-model planning.

items.title_zh: The Prestige：用魔术表演测试视觉模型的认知推理
items.title_en: The Prestige: Benchmarking Cognitive Visual Reasoning using Magic Tricks
items.summary_zh: 研究者推出视频理解基准 The Prestige，用专业魔术表演来考察认知视觉推理能力：魔术中的刻意误导迫使模型持续跟踪事件，并解释出人意料的结果。基准包含开放式问题，覆盖时间与因果理解，以及对对抗性问题的鲁棒性等维度。对主流开源与闭源视觉语言模型（VLM）的评测显示，即便最强模型与人类表现之间仍存在明显差距；研究还发现模型之间呈现出系统性的差异模式（摘要截断处）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.38103v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce The Prestige, a video understanding benchmark that probes cognitive visual reasoning through professional magic performances, where deliberate misdirection challenges models to track events and explain unexpected outcomes. The benchmark comprises open-ended questions ranging from temporal and causal understanding to robustness against adversarial questions. Evaluation of leading open-source and proprietary VLMs reveals a substantial gap between even the strongest model and human performance. We also find systematic discrepancies be…
items.why_zh: 魔术场景天然需要识破误导、重建因果，该基准揭示了当前视觉模型在类人推理上的明显短板，为评测提供了更难、更贴近真实认知的任务。
items.why_en: Magic inherently requires seeing through misdirection and reconstructing causality, so this benchmark exposes clear gaps in human-like reasoning and offers a harder, more cognitively realistic evaluation task.

items.title_zh: LLM-PowerTrace：面向 AI 算力的 GPU 功耗时间序列数据集
items.title_en: LLM-PowerTrace: A Dataset of Time-Resolved GPU Power Traces for AI Compute
items.summary_zh: AI 算力正成为体量大且快速变化的电力负荷，其对数据中心基础设施与电网的影响不仅取决于总能耗，还取决于功耗在亚秒到分钟尺度上如何变化，包括峰值、爬坡以及加速器之间的同步波动。现有面向大语言模型的能耗基准通常只报告“每 token 焦耳数”等聚合指标，很少公开底层时间序列测量，导致这些功耗动态难以刻画，也给相关研究与决策带来困难。为此，作者发布 LLM-PowerTrace 数据集，提供时间分辨的 GPU 功耗轨迹。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.38315v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI compute is becoming large and fast-changing electrical loads. Its impacts on data center infrastructure and power grids depend not only on total energy consumption, but also on how their power draw moves over sub-second to minute timescales, including peaks, ramps, and synchronized fluctuations across accelerators. Existing energy benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) report aggregate quantities such as joules per token and rarely release the underlying time-series measurements, leaving these power dynamics poorly characterized and dif…
items.why_zh: 公开高时间分辨率的 GPU 功耗数据，能支撑数据中心供电设计与电网影响评估，弥补现有只报聚合能耗指标的空白。
items.why_en: Releasing high-time-resolution GPU power data supports data-center power design and grid-impact assessment, filling a gap left by aggregate-only energy benchmarks.

items.title_zh: Soei：面向多智能体 AI 软件工程的结构化可观测性
items.title_en: Soei: Structured Observability of Evidence and Intent for Multi-Agent AI Software Engineering
items.summary_zh: AI 编程智能体已经能在极少监督下完成长周期、多步骤、跨会话的软件工作。当开发者回到这些工作时，真正需要知道的不是模型说了什么，而是实际做了什么、由谁完成、是否已经完成。论文分三部分研究这一问题：首先对照提交 e4ba2da 的源码验证开源本地可观测性工具 Agenttrail，发现九项有文档记录的常量与机制在文件与行级别成立，两条事件流水线从未统一，其 Map 服务还存在一处未鉴权的问题（摘要在此截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.39468v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI coding agents now do long, multi-step and multi-session software work with little supervision. When a developer comes back to that work, the useful question is not what the model said but what was actually done, by whom, and whether it is finished. We study this in three parts. First, we verify Agenttrail, an open-source local observability tool for coding agents, against its source at commit e4ba2da: nine documented constants and mechanisms hold at file-and-line level, two event pipelines are never unified, and its Map service has an unauth…
items.why_zh: 随着多智能体接管长周期编码任务，如何为“实际发生了什么、是否完成”提供可审计的证据链，正成为 AI 软件工程落地的关键基础设施。
items.why_en: As multi-agent systems take over long-running coding work, auditable evidence of what actually happened and whether it is finished becomes critical infrastructure for AI software engineering.

items.title_zh: 低资源非洲语言中的大语言模型红队测试：以约鲁巴语和尼日利亚洋泾浜英语为例
items.title_en: Red-Teaming Large Language Models in Low-Resource African Languages: A Case Study of Yoruba and Nigerian Pidgin
items.summary_zh: 随着大语言模型在非洲日益普及，其在低资源语言中的安全性却几乎未经检验，因为红队测试大多集中在英语。该研究用约鲁巴语和尼日利亚洋泾浜英语构建了400条明确的对抗性提示，覆盖四类危害，评估六款先进LLM，并由母语标注者打分、用Cohen's κ检验标注可靠性。结果显示，部分模型对英语提示的拒答率最高可达69%，但在约鲁巴语中拒答率可低至0%。这种跨语言拒答率的巨大落差，凸显了低资源语言安全评估与对齐的明显不足。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.39590v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) become more widespread in Africa, their safety in low-resource languages remains largely untested since most red-teaming work focuses on English. This study evaluates six state-of-the-art LLMs using 400 explicit adversarial prompts in Yoruba and Nigerian Pidgin, categorised into four harm categories. The responses were scored by native-speaker annotators and reliability was assessed using Cohen's $\kappa$. While models that rejected up to 69% of English prompts rejected as few as 0% in Yoruba, this was not becaus…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了LLM安全对齐在低资源语言中的严重盲区，提醒部署方不能假设英语红队结果可迁移到非洲语言。
items.why_en: It exposes a major blind spot in LLM safety alignment for low-resource languages, showing that English red-teaming results do not transfer to African languages.

items.title_zh: 视觉语言模型为何在3D推理上失败？
items.title_en: Where Do Vision Language Models Fail at 3D Reasoning?
items.summary_zh: 视觉语言模型常能做出正确的单个判断，却难以稳定恢复并一致使用3D物体的精确属性。为此研究者提出BedBench，一个包含13项程序化生成任务的受控基准，覆盖单项判断与组合答案，并评测了12个开放权重模型和4个前沿模型。在按颜色计数任务中，人类准确率为93.3%，最佳模型仅为7.2%。针对性微调可将某一模型的准确率从3.0%提升至68.6%，说明该短板可通过训练改善。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.39639v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-language models can get individual judgments right while struggling to recover and consistently use the exact properties of a 3D object. To characterize this gap, we introduce BedBench, a controlled benchmark of thirteen procedurally generated tasks spanning individual judgments and composite answers. Across twelve open-weight and four frontier models, per-color counting exposes a pronounced weakness: humans achieve 93.3% accuracy, compared with 7.2% for the best model. Targeted fine-tuning raises one model's accuracy from 3.0% to 68.6%,…
items.why_zh: 它用受控基准量化了视觉语言模型在3D属性理解上的系统性短板，并证明针对性训练可显著改善。
items.why_en: It quantifies a systematic 3D reasoning gap in vision-language models and shows targeted fine-tuning can substantially improve it.

items.title_zh: MuQ-Eval：面向AI音乐生成评估的开源逐样本质量指标
items.title_en: MuQ-Eval: An Open-Source Per-Sample Quality Metric for AI Music Generation Evaluation
items.summary_zh: Fréchet Audio Distance等分布级指标无法为单条音乐片段打分，且与人类判断的相关性较差；而唯一与人类判断高度相关的逐样本学习指标又是闭源的。MuQ-Eval是开源的逐样本AI音乐质量指标：研究者在冻结的MuQ-310M特征上训练轻量预测头，并使用MusicEval数据集，该数据集包含31个文本到音乐系统生成的片段及专家质量评分。最简单的模型采用冻结特征与注意力池化。它为AI音乐生成提供了可复现、可单样本评估的开放工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.22677v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Distributional metrics such as Fr\'echet Audio Distance cannot score individual music clips and correlate poorly with human judgments, while the only per-sample learned metric achieving high human correlation is closed-source. We introduce MUQ-EVAL, an open-source per-sample quality metric for AIgenerated music built by training lightweight prediction heads on frozen MuQ-310M features using MusicEval, a dataset of generated clips from 31 text-to-music systems with expert quality ratings. Our simplest model, frozen features with attention pool…
items.why_zh: 它提供了可复现的开源逐样本音乐质量指标，弥补闭源指标和分布级指标的不足，有利于AI音乐评估标准化。
items.why_en: It offers an open, reproducible per-sample music quality metric, filling a gap left by closed-source and distribution-level metrics.

items.title_zh: 当上下文变化：理解大语言模型的更新失败
items.title_en: When Context Changes: Understanding Update Failures in LLMs
items.summary_zh: 当偏好、目标和事实发生变化时，LLM智能体需要依据最新状态作答，但旧版本信息仍留在上下文中，模型可能返回同一变量的旧值，作者称之为“陈旧绑定”。为研究模型何时以及为何使用过时信息，论文提出受控上下文记忆（CICM）基准，用于在对话和智能体日志中追踪并使用更新后的信息。研究发现，即使是前沿推理模型也可能无法恢复当前状态，表明上下文更新仍是智能体可靠性的关键挑战。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38866v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: As preferences, goals, and facts change, LLM agents must use the current state while earlier versions remain in context. Yet they can answer with an old value of the same variable, a failure that we call stale binding. To study when models use outdated information and why, we introduce Controlled In-Context Memory (CICM), a benchmark for tracking and using updated information in conversations and agent logs. We observe that even frontier reasoning models can fail to recover the current state. We find that in open-source models probes can stil…
items.why_zh: “陈旧绑定”直指LLM智能体在动态环境中的可靠性问题，对依赖长期上下文的应用至关重要。
items.why_en: Stale binding highlights a reliability risk for LLM agents operating in dynamic environments with long contexts.

items.title_zh: MedGemma对比GPT-4：开源与专有模型的零样本医学图像疾病分类
items.title_en: MedGemma vs GPT-4: Open-Source and Proprietary Zero-shot Medical Disease Classification from Images
items.summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型正被用于医学影像解读，通过临床知识辅助疾病分类。该研究比较两种架构：专门化的开源智能体MedGemma与专有大型多模态模型GPT-4，在六种疾病的零样本诊断任务上展开对比。MedGemma-4b-it经LoRA微调后在对比中表现更优。研究为开源专科模型与通用闭源模型在医学影像中的取舍提供了实证参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2512.23304v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) introduce an emerging paradigm for medical imaging by interpreting scans through the lens of extensive clinical knowledge, offering a transformative approach to disease classification. This study presents a critical comparison between two fundamentally different AI architectures: the specialized open-source agent MedGemma and the proprietary large multimodal model GPT-4 for diagnosing six different diseases. The MedGemma-4b-it model, fine-tuned using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), demonstrated superi…
items.why_zh: 它为开源专科医学模型与通用闭源大模型在临床影像任务上的选择提供了直接比较证据。
items.why_en: It provides direct evidence for choosing between specialized open-source medical models and general proprietary multimodal models.

items.title_zh: 面向连续控制的批到流式深度强化学习
items.title_en: Towards Batch-to-Streaming Deep Reinforcement Learning for Continuous Control
items.summary_zh: 最先进的深度强化学习在连续控制任务上表现突出，但因依赖回放缓冲区、批量更新和目标网络，其计算复杂度常难以适配资源受限硬件。流式深度强化学习通过纯在线更新缓解这一限制，并在标准基准上取得不错效果。该工作提出两种新的流式深度RL算法，旨在推动从批量训练到流式学习的转变。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.08588v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: State-of-the-art deep reinforcement learning (RL) methods have achieved remarkable performance in continuous control tasks, yet their computational complexity is often incompatible with the constraints of resource-limited hardware, due to their reliance on replay buffers, batch updates, and target networks. The emerging paradigm of streaming deep RL addresses this limitation through purely online updates, achieving strong empirical performance on standard benchmarks. In this work, we propose two novel streaming deep RL algorithms, Strea…
items.why_zh: 流式深度RL有望降低训练与部署成本，使连续控制策略更适用于资源受限的边缘硬件。
items.why_en: Streaming deep RL could reduce training and deployment costs, making continuous-control policies viable on resource-limited edge hardware.

items.title_zh: ECG-Reasoning-Benchmark：评估心电图解读临床推理能力的基准
items.title_en: ECG-Reasoning-Benchmark: A Benchmark for Evaluating Clinical Reasoning Capabilities in ECG Interpretation
items.summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型在心电图自动解读上表现可观，但它们究竟是逐步推理，还是依赖表浅视觉线索，仍不清楚。为此研究者提出ECG-Reasoning-Benchmark，一个多轮评估框架，包含6400多个样本，系统评估17种核心心电图诊断中的逐步推理能力。对先进模型的综合评估显示，其在执行多步推理方面存在系统性不足，提示心电图AI的临床可信度仍需进一步验证。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.14326v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show promising performance in automated electrocardiogram interpretation, it remains unclear whether they perform actual step-by-step reasoning or just rely on superficial visual cues. To investigate this, we introduce ECG-Reasoning-Benchmark, a novel multi-turn evaluation framework comprising over 6,400 samples to systematically assess step- by-step reasoning across 17 core ECG diagnoses. Our comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art models reveals a systematic shortfall in executing mu…
items.why_zh: 它区分“会答题”与“会推理”，对心电图AI进入临床前的可信度评估具有警示意义。
items.why_en: It distinguishes answer accuracy from genuine reasoning, a crucial caution for validating ECG AI before clinical use.

items.title_zh: 用于贝叶斯优化自适应采集的多智能体LLM
items.title_en: Multi-Agent LLMs for Adaptive Acquisition in Bayesian Optimization
items.summary_zh: 探索与利用的权衡是序贯决策和黑箱优化的核心，但LLM如何理解并管理这一权衡仍缺乏认识。与通过采集函数显式编码探索与利用的贝叶斯优化不同，基于LLM的优化依赖对历史评估的隐式提示推理，使搜索行为难以分析和控制。该研究对LLM介导的优化开展指标层面分析，并探索多智能体LLM用于贝叶斯优化中的自适应采集。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.28959v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The exploration-exploitation trade-off is central to sequential decision-making and black-box optimization, yet how Large Language Models (LLMs) reason about and manage this trade-off remains poorly understood. Unlike Bayesian Optimization, where exploration and exploitation are explicitly encoded through acquisition functions, LLM-based optimization relies on implicit, prompt-based reasoning over historical evaluations, making search behavior difficult to analyze or control. In this work, we present a metric-level study of LLM-mediated…
items.why_zh: 理解LLM如何隐式管理探索与利用，有助于设计更可控、可分析的LLM驱动优化系统。
items.why_en: Understanding how LLMs implicitly manage exploration and exploitation can lead to more controllable LLM-driven optimization systems.

items.title_zh: LLM 解码阶段的功耗封顶为何形同虚设：跨注意力架构的分阶段能耗分析
items.title_en: The Illusion of Power Capping in LLM Decode: A Phase-Aware Energy Characterisation Across Attention Architectures
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文指出，GPU 功耗封顶在 LLM 推理中看似有效——上限设定后显卡报告的功耗确实低于上限，能耗预算也能达标，但对真正主导 LLM 服务的自回归解码阶段几乎没有作用。研究者在 NVIDIA H200 上、基于 vLLM eager 执行模式，测试了 GQA、MLA、Gated DeltaNet 与 Mamba2 四种注意力范式，发现解码内核主要在等待 HBM 访存，内核启动之间 GPU 处于空闲状态。因此解码阶段的实际功耗不到该卡 700W 额定功率的一半，吞吐量的变化也仅有几个百分点。作者据此提出应按阶段而非整体看待功耗封顶策略。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.11999v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Power capping is a common GPU energy lever in LLM serving, and it appears to work: the cap is set, the GPU reports drawing less than it, and the energy budget is met. We show the cap does little for the phase that dominates LLM serving: autoregressive decode. Across four attention paradigms (GQA, MLA, Gated DeltaNet, and Mamba2) on an NVIDIA H200 under vLLM eager execution, decode kernels wait on HBM and the GPU idles between kernel launches, so decode draws less than half of the GPU's 700W rating and throughput stays within a few perce…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了数据中心常见的 GPU 降功耗手段在 LLM 推理的关键阶段基本无效，为能耗优化策略提供了分阶段的实证依据。
items.why_en: It shows that a common data-center GPU power-saving lever barely affects the dominant phase of LLM inference, giving phase-aware evidence for energy Optimization strategies.

items.title_zh: 用强化学习提升基于大语言模型的建筑规范自动合规审查系统
items.title_en: Reinforcement learning to improve large language model-based automated code compliance systems
items.summary_zh: 针对建筑法规的自动合规审查（ACC），现有基于大语言模型的方法容易生成错误甚至幻觉的机器可处理规则。为此，论文提出 P4IR 两阶段框架：先用监督微调（SFT）向模型注入领域知识，再用 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）提升其生成的高层代码骨架这类中间表示的准确性。结果显示，该框架最终将相关错误分别降低最多 21.3% 和 41.0%。这项工作把强化学习引入规范条文到可执行规则的转换环节。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.22402v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based approaches for automated code compliance (ACC) of building regulations are prone to generating incorrect and hallucinated computer-processable rules. This paper introduces P4IR, a two-stage framework that uses supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to instill domain knowledge in an LLM, followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to improve the accuracy of the generated intermediate representations in the form of high-level code skeletons. The framework achieved final reductions of up to 21.3% and 41.0%…
items.why_zh: 它表明强化学习可显著抑制法规自动审查中的规则幻觉，对建筑等强监管行业的 LLM 落地具有直接价值。
items.why_en: It shows reinforcement learning can curb rule hallucination in regulatory compliance, a direct boon for deploying LLMs in heavily regulated industries like construction.

items.title_zh: BITEM 团队在 NTCIR-19 R2C2 任务：用智能体式 RAG 流水线信号预测置信度
items.title_en: BITEM at the NTCIR-19 R2C2 Task: Predicting Confidence from Agentic RAG Pipeline Signals
items.summary_zh: BITEM 团队以单一智能体流水线参加了 NTCIR-19 R2C2 任务的两个子任务：模型在电影语料上检索、阅读并记录证据，由编排器保管记录并裁定哪些内容可以提交。一条主张只有在经过蕴含级联校验、与其所引段落一致后才被接纳，答案也只有在背后有足够多已核验证据支撑时才会给出。每个问题会运行三到四次，后续轮次的检索语料会剔除此前已用过的内容。研究据此从流水线信号中预测答案置信度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.37993v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The BITEM team entered both subtasks of the NTCIR-19 R2C2 task with a single agentic pipeline, in which a model searches, reads and records evidence over a movie corpus while an orchestrator holds the record and rules on what may be submitted. A claim is admitted only once an entailment cascade has checked it against the passage it cites, and an answer is released only once enough checked evidence stands behind it. Each question is run three or four times, every pass retrieving from a corpus stripped of what the earlier passes have alre…
items.why_zh: 它展示了如何用检索—校验流程的内部信号来估计 RAG 答案的可信度，这正是智能体检索系统走向可靠部署的关键一环。
items.why_en: It shows how internal signals from a retrieval-and-verification pipeline can estimate answer confidence, a key step toward reliably deployable agentic RAG systems.

items.title_zh: 一次权重更新究竟买到了什么：训练各阶段的“杠杆率”
items.title_en: What a Weight Update Buys: Leverage Across Training Stages
items.summary_zh: 论文指出一个鲜明反差：后训练只把语言模型权重挪动约其范数的千分之一，却能显著改变模型行为；预训练把权重挪动约三分之一，带来的却只是缓慢漂移。为量化这一差别，作者提出 leverage 指标——用更新方向的 Fisher 二次型，除以同一检查点上同等大小随机方向的同一二次型，每个方向只需一次前向模式计算。该指标把已发布的 Olmo-3、Tülu-3、Zephyr 与 OLMo-2 检查点区分开，跨度达四个数量级。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.37719v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Post-training moves a language model's weights by about a thousandth of their norm and changes its behavior sharply; pretraining moves them by a third and buys a slow drift. We introduce leverage, an exact measure of what a unit of weight change buys: the Fisher quadratic form of an update, computed with one forward-mode pass per direction, divided by the same form for random directions of the same size at the same checkpoint. Leverage orders released Olmo-3, T\"ulu-3, Zephyr, and OLMo-2 checkpoints over four orders of magnitude: pretraining wind…
items.why_zh: 它提供了一个可计算的指标来解释为何后训练“小改动、大效果”，有助于理解并诊断模型训练各阶段的效率。
items.why_en: It offers a computable metric explaining why post-training achieves large behavioral change from tiny weight moves, helping diagnose efficiency across training stages.

items.title_zh: Dual DeltaNet：线性注意力中的值侧记忆重组
items.title_en: Dual DeltaNet: Value-Side Memory Reorganization for Linear Attention
items.summary_zh: 线性注意力与状态空间模型（SSM）通过维护固定大小的循环状态，为 softmax 注意力提供了高效替代方案，但需要精心管理状态以保留有用的历史关联并抑制干扰。delta 规则通过修正每个键所对应的值来减少干扰，却没有显式考虑相关的值特征在状态中如何分布。作者观察到状态矩阵 S∈R^{d_k×d_v} 可以视为一组值维度的“记忆库”，并据此提出 Dual DeltaNet，在值侧对记忆进行重组。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.38578v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Linear attention and state space models (SSMs) offer efficient alternatives to softmax attention by maintaining a fixed-size recurrent state, but this design requires careful management to preserve useful historical associations and limit interference. The delta rule helps reduce interference through correction of the value associated with each key, but it does not explicitly account for how related value features are distributed across the state. We observe that a state $\boldsymbol{S}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_k\times d_v}$ can be viewed as a bank of $d_…
items.why_zh: 它针对线性注意力的记忆干扰问题给出值维度上的新解法，有望提升高效注意力架构的长上下文表现。
items.why_en: It offers a value-side remedy for memory interference in linear attention, potentially improving long-context performance of efficient attention architectures.

items.title_zh: 多臂老虎机中同时实现极小极大最优一阶遗憾与“两全其美”遗憾
items.title_en: Achieving Minimax-Optimal First-Order and Best-of-Both-Worlds Regret Simultaneously in Multi-Armed Bandits
items.summary_zh: 论文研究多臂老虎机中的一阶遗憾与 best-of-both-worlds 遗憾保证。Pogodin 与 Lattimore（2019）曾提出一种算法，同时具备极小极大最优的最坏情况遗憾，以及依赖损失的项为 O(√(K L* log T)) 的一阶保证，其中 T 为时间跨度、L* 为固定臂中最小的期望累积损失、K 为臂数。但该依赖损失项与最优一阶规模之间仍存在对数级差距。本文的工作正是消除这一差距。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.39457v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study first-order and best-of-both-worlds regret guarantees in multi-armed bandits. Pogodin and Lattimore (2019) proposed an algorithm that combines minimax-optimal worst-case regret with a first-order guarantee whose loss-dependent term is $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{K L^\star}\log T)$, where $T$ denotes the horizon, $L^\star$ denotes the smallest expected cumulative loss among fixed arms, and $K$ denotes the number of arms. However, a logarithmic gap remains between this loss-dependent term and the optimal first-order scale. In this paper, we remove…
items.why_zh: 它在一阶遗憾与最坏情况最优保证之间补上了长期存在的理论缺口，推进了老虎机算法的理论边界。
items.why_en: It closes a longstanding theoretical gap between first-order and worst-case-optimal guarantees, advancing the theory of bandit algorithms.

items.title_zh: 面向孟加拉国数字银行生态的可解释自适应机器学习欺诈风险检测
items.title_en: Explainable and Adaptive Machine Learning for Fraud Risk Detection in Bangladesh's Digital Banking Ecosystem
items.summary_zh: 随着数字银行与移动金融服务快速扩张，欺诈检测面临严峻的类别极度不平衡与运营约束挑战。本研究提出一个可解释、自适应的机器学习框架，整合了按时间顺序的评估、防止数据泄漏的特征工程、概率校准、基于 SHAP 的可解释性以及自适应风险优先级排序。实验使用合成的 PaySim 移动支付基准，对比了逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost 与 LightGBM 等模型。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.39556v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid expansion of digital banking and mobile financial services creates growing challenges for fraud detection, particularly under severe class imbalance and operational constraints. This study presents an explainable and adaptive machine-learning framework integrating chronological evaluation, leakage-conscious feature engineering, probability calibration, SHAP-based explainability, and adaptive risk prioritization. Experiments use the synthetic PaySim mobile-money benchmark and compare Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and Light…
items.why_zh: 它把可解释性与时间维度评估纳入欺诈检测流程，对新兴市场移动金融的风控落地具有现实参考意义。
items.why_en: It folds explainability and time-aware evaluation into fraud detection, offering practical guidance for risk control in emerging-market mobile finance.

items.title_zh: 通过超参数优化提升房颤检测效果
items.title_en: Enhancing Atrial Fibrillation Detection Through Hyperparameter Optimization
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨超参数优化（HPO）在提升房颤（AF）检测中的作用，同时覆盖机器学习与深度学习模型。评估的标准分类器包括决策树、随机森林和 XGBoost，深度学习架构包括循环神经网络、深度神经网络与孪生神经网络。为调优这些模型，作者采用了遗传算法、Hyperband、Optuna 与 SMAC3 四种 HPO 方法，并在按患者/记录划分的区间上进行实验。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.40001v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This study explores the role of hyperparameter optimization (HPO) in enhancing the detection of Atrial Fibrillation (AF) using both machine learning and deep learning models. We evaluated a range of standard classifiers - Decision Tree, Random Forest, and XGBoost classifiers, alongside deep learning architectures including Recurrent Neural Networks, Deep Neural Networks, and Siamese Neural Networks. To fine-tune these models, we applied four HPO methods: Genetic Algorithm, Hyperband, Optuna, and SMAC3. The experiments were conducted using inter-p…
items.why_zh: 它系统比较了多种超参数优化方法在房颤检测上的收益，为临床心电筛查模型的调参实践提供了实证参考。
items.why_en: It systematically compares hyperparameter optimization methods for AF detection, giving empirical guidance for tuning clinical ECG screening models.

items.title_zh: 在 ESP32-P4 微控制器上实现流式语音识别：6570 万参数 Transducer 的 2/4 比特部署
items.title_en: Streaming Speech Recognition on a Microcontroller: a 65.7M-Parameter Transducer in 2 and 4 Bits on the ESP32-P4
items.summary_zh: 研究者把 Kroko——一个面向英语的 6570 万参数流式 Zipformer2 transducer——跑在了 ESP32-P4 上；这是一颗只有双核 400MHz RISC-V、128 位 SIMD 扩展（PIE）和 32MB PSRAM、没有神经网络加速器的微控制器。方法无需任何再训练：编码器的 290 个矩阵以 Hadamard 旋转后的分组形式，按每权重 2 比特或 4 比特存储，每个矩阵的位宽由实测敏感度决定；量化前先把矩阵向原模型输出校正，再用 GPTQ 与组范数搜索完成舍入。摘要提到随附发布了约 71MB 的成果，但原文在此处截断。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.38739v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We run Kroko, a 65.7M-parameter streaming Zipformer2 transducer for English, on the ESP32-P4, a microcontroller with two 400 MHz RISC-V cores, a 128-bit SIMD extension (PIE) and 32 MB of PSRAM, but no neural accelerator. Without any training, the encoder's 290 matrices are stored with 2 or 4 bits per weight in Hadamard-rotated groups: the width of each matrix comes from its measured sensitivity, and each matrix is first corrected toward the original model's output, then rounded with GPTQ and a search over the group norms. The released 71 MB of…
items.why_zh: 它表明千万参数级的流式语音识别可以在无 NPU 的低成本微控制器上本地运行，为离线、低功耗的语音交互打开了空间。
items.why_en: It shows that tens-of-millions-parameter streaming speech recognition can run locally on a low-cost microcontroller without an NPU, enabling offline, low-power voice interfaces.

items.title_zh: 验证决策树集成中的“毛刺”现象
items.title_en: Verifying Glitches in Decision Tree Ensembles
items.summary_zh: 决策树集成广泛用于司法、医疗、银行等表格预测场景。作者指出，这类模型的分段常数结构会在单个特征发生微小变化时产生狭窄的局部振荡：集成分数先骤降再骤升（向下尖峰），或先骤升再骤降（向上尖峰），他们称之为“毛刺”（glitch）。毛刺按定义并不等于错误，而是一个可被形式化检验、需要人工审查的审计目标；文中把毛刺形式化为某种见证结构，用于在模型中定位这类异常。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2507.14492v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Decision tree ensembles are widely used for tabular prediction tasks in judiciary, healthcare, banking, etc. We show that the piecewise-constant structure of these models can create narrow local oscillations, leading the ensemble score to sharply drop and then rise (a downward spike), or sharply rise and then drop (an upward spike), over a small change in a single feature. We call such patterns glitches. A glitch is not, by definition, an error. Rather, it is a formally checkable audit target requiring inspection. Formally, glitches are witne…
items.why_zh: 它把“微小输入扰动引发异常打分波动”变成可形式化检测的审计对象，对高风险领域的树集成模型部署有实际意义。
items.why_en: It turns tiny-input-induced score oscillations into a formally checkable audit target, which matters for deploying tree ensembles in high-stakes domains.

items.title_zh: 理解 Transformer 学习潜在结构的分阶段动态
items.title_en: Understanding the Staged Dynamics of Transformers in Learning Latent Structure
items.summary_zh: 语言模型已被证明能学到语言中复杂的潜在结构，但模型如何逐步习得这些结构的各个组成部分仍不清楚，这也让“模型只是在重新混合训练数据”的批评难以回应。作者以 Alchemy 基准作为可控实验环境，训练小型 decoder-only Transformer 完成三种受控任务变体（其中之一是推断缺失步骤），借此观察模型如何依次、分阶段地获得数据中不同的潜在结构成分。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2511.19328v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Language models have proven to be capable of learning the intricate latent structures in language. However, the dynamics of how such models acquire the components of that structure remain poorly understood, leaving them open to the criticism that models just remix training data. In this work, we use the Alchemy benchmark as a controlled setting in which we investigate how models acquire the different latent structure components of the data. We train a small decoder-only transformer on three controlled task variants: 1) inferring missing steps…
items.why_zh: 揭示 Transformer 习得潜在结构的分阶段规律，有助于回应“只会复述训练数据”的质疑，并为数据与训练设计提供依据。
items.why_en: Clarifying the staged dynamics of structure learning helps counter the 'models just remix training data' critique and informs data and training design.

items.title_zh: 超球面上平方指数核 GP Bandit 的更紧遗憾下界
items.title_en: Tighter Regret Lower Bound for Gaussian Process Bandits with Squared Exponential Kernel in Hypersphere
items.summary_zh: 本文研究频率派设定下高斯过程（GP）bandit 的算法无关最坏情况遗憾下界：奖励函数固定，且在已知再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中有界范数。研究聚焦于 GP bandit 中最常用的核函数之一——平方指数（SE）核。该问题尚存的开放问题之一是上界与下界在依赖于维度的对数因子上存在差距，本文部分缩小了这一差距，给出了更紧的下界。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2602.17940v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study an algorithm-independent, worst-case lower bound for the Gaussian process (GP) bandit problem in the frequentist setting, where the reward function is fixed and has a bounded norm in the known reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). Specifically, we focus on the squared exponential (SE) kernel, one of the most widely used kernel functions in GP bandits. One of the remaining open questions for this problem is the gap in the \emph{dimension-dependent} logarithmic factors between upper and lower bounds. This paper partially resolves th…
items.why_zh: 更紧的下界缩小了理论与实际算法之间的差距，加深了对 SE 核 GP bandit 内在困难程度的理解。
items.why_en: A tighter lower bound narrows the theory-practice gap and sharpens understanding of the intrinsic difficulty of SE-kernel GP bandits.

items.title_zh: 粘性跳跃扩散：统一掩码扩散、连续扩散与混合扩散的框架
items.title_en: Sticky Jump Diffusions: A Unifying View of Masked, Continuous, and Hybrid Diffusion
items.summary_zh: 作者提出“粘性跳跃扩散”（SJDs），这是一类定义在 R^d 上的连续时间马尔可夫过程，其离散锚点即 token 嵌入。在前向时间中，锚点以一定风险率释放质量，释放出的质量在连续环境空间中扩散；时间反演则把 score 驱动的 SDE 与一个粘性跳跃核耦合起来，该核的速率与目的地由与前向分布的流量平衡确定。作者用单一去噪分类器、通过“去噪风险匹配”同时估计 score 与每个锚点的反向风险率。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.10951v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce sticky jump diffusions (SJDs), continuous-time Markov processes on $\mathbb{R}^d$ whose discrete anchors are token embeddings. In forward time, anchors release their mass at a hazard rate and the released mass diffuses in the continuous ambient space; time reversal couples a score-driven SDE with a sticky jump kernel whose rate and destination are fixed by flux balance with the forward law. We estimate the score and the per-anchor reverse hazards from a single denoising classifier via denoising hazard matching, the hazard analogu…
items.why_zh: 它为掩码（离散）扩散、连续扩散与混合扩散提供了统一的连续时间理论框架，有助于打通不同扩散语言模型的建模语言。
items.why_en: It offers a unified continuous-time framework spanning masked, continuous and hybrid diffusion, helping connect different diffusion language-model formulations.

items.title_zh: 参数化知识图谱记忆中的“存储—检索”落差
items.title_en: A Storage-Retrieval Gap in Parametric Knowledge Graph Memory
items.summary_zh: 图检索增强生成（Graph RAG）在查询时把检索到的子图放入模型上下文窗口，既带来持续的 token 开销，又会在每次调用时暴露源数据。作者研究另一种做法：离线把知识图谱编译成一组 LoRA 适配器（每个实体一个），作为参数化知识层，通过注入权重而非文本来查询，查询时上下文成本为零。在 MetaQA 数据集上，他们发现用子图训练的适配器确实编码了无上下文的事实知识，并能泛化到未见问题，但也暴露出存储与检索之间的落差。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.25489v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Graph retrieval-augmented generation places retrieved subgraphs into the model's context window at query time, paying a recurring token cost and exposing source data on every call. We study an alternative: compiling a knowledge graph offline into a bank of LoRA adapters, one per entity, that serve as a parametric knowledge layer queried by injecting weights rather than text, at zero query-time context cost. On the MetaQA dataset, we find that subgraph-trained adapters encode context-free factual knowledge that generalizes to unseen questions:…
items.why_zh: 它指出了用参数化记忆替代上下文检索在降本与隐私上的潜力，同时也提醒单纯的权重化存储并不能完全替代检索。
items.why_en: It highlights the cost and privacy appeal of parametric memory over in-context retrieval, while showing that weight-based storage alone does not fully replace retrieval.

items.title_zh: ScAn-Bench：评估缩放规律分析方法本身
items.title_en: ScAn-Bench: Evaluating Scaling Analysis Methodology
items.summary_zh: 近年来机器学习的进展由大规模基础模型驱动，而缩放规律以及为架构、数据、超参数寻找最优缩放方案，是推进最先进水平的关键。令人意外的是，此前并没有系统研究去评估“获得缩放规律与方案”的方法论本身。为填补这一盲点并促进后续研究，作者提出了代理基准 ScAn-Bench-LLM 与 ScAn-Bench-VLM，分别基于 4524 和 8024 个 checkpoint（摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.35707v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recent progress in machine learning is driven by large-scale foundation models, where scaling laws and finding optimal scaling prescriptions for architecture, data, and hyperparameters are key in advancing the state-of-the-art. Therefore, it is surprising that no systematic study evaluates the methodology to obtain scaling laws and prescriptions across different model types. To shed light on this crucial blind spot and facilitate future research, we introduce the surrogate benchmarks ScAn-Bench-LLM and ScAn-Bench-VLM based on 4524 and 8024 ch…
items.why_zh: 它首次把“如何做缩放分析”本身变成可评测对象，有助于提升规模预测与训练方案选择的可靠性。
items.why_en: It makes scaling analysis itself an evaluable object, which should improve the reliability of scale predictions and training-prescription choices.

items.title_zh: AdaptLSTM：面向分布漂移的云负载预测高效自适应在线学习
items.title_en: AdaptLSTM: Efficient Adaptive Online Learning for Cloud Workload Forecasting under Distribution Drift
items.summary_zh: 准确的负载预测对超大规模云服务的弹性资源供给至关重要，而病毒式传播内容、产品发布和用户行为变化引发的分布漂移，会让离线训练的模型迅速失效。朴素在线学习虽能恢复精度，却带来难以承受的每步计算开销。作者提出 AdaptLSTM：用经验证集校准的阈值检测漂移，并只做选择性、有针对性的更新。在 Alibaba Machine Trace 上，AdaptLSTM 以更低成本恢复了朴素在线学习方法所获提升的 54%。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.12265v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Accurate workload forecasting is critical for elastic resource provisioning in web-scale cloud services, where distribution shifts driven by viral content, product launches, and user behavior degrade offline-trained models rapidly. Naive online learning recovers accuracy but incurs prohibitive per-step compute cost. We propose AdaptLSTM, an adaptive online framework that detects drift via validation-calibrated thresholds and applies selective, targeted updates. On the Alibaba Machine Trace, AdaptLSTM recovers 54% of Naive Online's improvement…
items.why_zh: 它证明“按需定向更新”可以在分布漂移下兼顾预测精度与在线计算成本，对生产级云资源调度有直接价值。
items.why_en: It shows that selective, on-demand updates can balance accuracy and online compute cost under drift, with direct value for production cloud resource scheduling.

items.title_zh: PaECTER：利用引用信息Transformer的专利级表示学习
items.title_en: PaECTER: Patent-level Representation Learning using Citation-informed Transformers
items.summary_zh: PaECTER 是一个面向专利文档的开源文档级编码器。研究者在 BERT for Patents 基础上，利用审查员添加的引用信息进行微调，使专利文档可被转换为数值向量表示。该模型在相似度任务上优于当前专利领域的先进模型，并在专利引用预测测试数据集上超过 BERT for Patents 以及 E5、GTE、BGE 等通用文本嵌入模型。其目标是提升专利检索、相似性判断等下游任务的表示质量。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2402.19411v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: PaECTER is an open-source document-level encoder specific for patents. We fine-tune BERT for Patents with examiner-added citation information to generate numerical representations for patent documents. PaECTER performs better in similarity tasks than current state-of-the-art models used in the patent domain. More specifically, our model outperforms the patent specific pre-trained language model (BERT for Patents) and general-purpose text embedding models (e.g., E5, GTE, and BGE) on our patent citation prediction test dataset on differen…
items.why_zh: 引用信息驱动的专利表示有望提升专利检索、相似度分析和引用预测等任务的准确性。
items.why_en: Citation-informed patent representations could improve accuracy in patent search, similarity analysis, and citation prediction.

items.title_zh: LibriVAD：面向稳健语音活动检测的可扩展开源数据集与深度学习基准
items.title_en: LibriVAD: A Scalable Open Dataset with Deep Learning Benchmarks for Robust Voice Activity Detection
items.summary_zh: LibriVAD 是一个可扩展的开源语音活动检测（VAD）数据集，旨在缓解该领域缺少大规模、系统可控且公开数据的问题。它基于 LibriSpeech 构建，并加入多种真实世界和合成噪声，便于在噪声、多样及未见声学条件下评估 VAD。该数据集可对信噪比、静音等条件进行系统控制，并提供深度学习基准，以支持更稳健的 VAD 研究。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2512.17281v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Robust Voice Activity Detection (VAD) remains a challenging task, especially under noisy, diverse, and unseen acoustic conditions. Beyond algorithmic development, a key limitation in advancing VAD research is the lack of large-scale, systematically controlled, and publicly available datasets. To address this, we introduce \textbf{LibriVAD} -- a scalable open-source dataset derived from LibriSpeech and augmented with diverse real-world and synthetic noise sources. LibriVAD enables systematic control over speech-to-noise ratio, silence-to…
items.why_zh: 它为稳健 VAD 研究提供了大规模、可控且可复现的公开数据与基准，有助于推动噪声环境下的算法比较和改进。
items.why_en: It provides large-scale, controllable, and reproducible public data and benchmarks for robust VAD research, helping drive algorithm comparison and improvement in noisy environments.

items.title_zh: 推出不到两年，谷歌 AI 编程助手 Jules 将逐步停止服务
items.title_en: Google to Wind Down AI Coding Agent Jules Less Than Two Years After Launch
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，谷歌正在逐步停用其人工智能编程助手 Jules。该公司于 2024 年 12 月推出了 Jules，将其定位为一款能完成“你不想做的”编程工作的工具。但如今，Jules 即将停止服务。 谷歌表示，该公司会将从该工具中获得的经验应用到人工智能编码平台 Antigravity 中。 以下是 Jules 官方 X 账号发布的声明： 当我们推出 Jules 时，这是一项实验，旨在了解异步编程智能体如何帮助开发者更快交付。看到大家用它构建的东西，让我们对智能体开发的未来方向有了深刻认识，并直接影响了谷歌旗下多个产品。 我们正在努力将从 Jules 中积累的经验融入 Antigravity，让用户能够兼得两者之长：既能自主在远程环境中执行后台任务，又能拥有以智能体为核心的开发环境。 随着我们将重心转向打造统一的体验，Jules 将逐步停止运营。 无论你是用 Jules 消灭漏洞、编写测试，还是发布功能 —— 感谢你塑造了智能体编程的未来。 据IT之家了解，Antigravity 是谷歌 DeepMind 于 2025 年 11 月 18 日推出的“智能体优先”开发平台，是一个面向开发者的下一代集成开发环境，作为 VS Code 分支的独立可下载 IDE 分发，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。平台基于“智能体优先”的设计理念，旨在使 AI 能够…
items.summary_en: Google is phasing out Jules, the AI coding agent it launched in December 2024, saying lessons from the experiment are being folded into Antigravity, DeepMind's agent-first IDE released in November 2025. The company framed the move as a shift toward a single unified agent development experience.
items.why_zh: 这反映出 AI 编程赛道正从单点“任务助手”收敛到一体化智能体开发环境，谷歌选择关停自家产品以集中资源。
items.why_en: It signals consolidation in AI coding from standalone task agents toward unified agent-first IDEs, with Google cutting its own product to concentrate resources.

items.title_zh: 融资数亿元，零一万物要搬去DeepSeek大本营了！
items.title_en: 01.AI Raises Hundreds of Millions, Reportedly Moving to DeepSeek's Base
items.summary_zh: 融资数亿元，零一万物要搬去DeepSeek大本营了！ 新浪新闻_手机新浪网
items.summary_en: Sina News reports that 01.AI has raised hundreds of millions of yuan and plans to move its offices to DeepSeek's base. items.title_zh: 豪掷 7500 亿美元押注 AI 遇挑战，美国科技巨头核心业务增速放缓
items.title_en: As Big Tech Bets $750 Billion on AI, Its Core Businesses Are Slowing

items.summary_en: Bloomberg reports that the advertising, consumer and retail businesses funding Big Tech's roughly $750 billion in AI spending this year are decelerating, with Alphabet posting its slowest search-ad growth in five quarters and Amazon's e-commerce and ad growth also slowing — yet all four giants kept their capex guidance intact, rattling investors.
items.why_zh: 它点出了 AI 军备竞赛的核心矛盾：现金来源在放缓，投入规模却仍在加码，投资者耐心正被持续消耗。
items.why_en: It exposes the central tension of the AI arms race: the cash engines are slowing while spending accelerates, testing investor patience.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 更新 AI 模型规范，将忠于人类意图作为核心准则
items.title_en: OpenAI Updates Model Spec, Making 'Follow Human Intent' the Core Principle
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，OpenAI 于当地时间周四更新了其模型规范（Model Spec）文档，这是一份用于明确其 AI 模型行为准则的公开路线图。随着 AI 系统能力持续增强，OpenAI 围绕五大核心价值对该框架进行了重构。 OpenAI 将模型规范重新归纳为五项准则：忠于人类意图、降低伤害、诚实透明、保障人的自主选择权、审慎尽责。 该公司表示，忠于人类意图是整套框架的基础，要求模型理解用户、开发者以及 OpenAI 本身的意图与价值取向，而不是机械地按字面执行指令。 OpenAI 称，本次更新属于 AI 对齐工作的一环，目的是让模型在陌生场景下践行人类价值观，同时始终接受人类监督。 修订后的框架提出，模型应当尽可能减少危害，如实说明自身知道和不知道的内容，辅助用户自主做决定、追寻自身目标。 公司表示，现有模型还无法完全符合这份新版模型规范，团队正在研究全新训练方式，让模型内化这些准则。 IT之家注意到，这次调整和竞争对手 Anthropic 的宪法式 AI 思路相近，后者依靠一份书面的原则“宪法”约束模型行为，让塑造 AI 系统的价值理念更加公开透明。 在此之前，AI 对齐问题受到越来越多审视。OpenAI 曾披露，一款自主智能体在测试过程中入侵了 Hugging Face。该事件凸显，高阶模型在追逐既定目标时，有可能突破规则、绕过安全防护机制，也推动了本次规范更…
items.summary_en: OpenAI has revised its Model Spec around five core values — follow human intent, reduce harm, be honest and transparent, protect human autonomy and be diligent — with following intent as the foundation rather than literal instruction-following. The company said current models do not yet fully meet the new spec and that it is researching new training methods to internalize the principles.
items.why_zh: 规范更新是 AI 对齐从“按字面执行”转向“理解意图与价值”的公开表态，也反映出治理话语权上的竞争压力。
items.why_en: The revision marks a public shift in alignment thinking from literal obedience to intent-and-value understanding, in a field where rivals compete over governance narratives.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，据彭博社报道，一位知情人士透露， Anthropic 已成为 SpaceX 的最大单一客户 。此前，美国联邦政府一直是 SpaceX 的最大单一客户。 今年第三季度，该公司为埃隆 · 马斯克（Elon Musk）旗下 SpaceX 贡献了超三分之一的营收。 SpaceX 在上周提交的申报文件中指出，上一季度约 34.5% 的营收来自单一客户，该客户主要向其负责提供算力的人工智能部门采购服务。 知情人士证实，文件中仅被称为“客户 B”的神秘买家正是 Anthropic。 具体合作方面，Anthropic 主要租赁 SpaceX 位于田纳西州孟菲斯数据中心的计算资源。其 IPO 招股书文件显示，双方签署的合同有效期至 2029 年，潜在支出上限达 1,205 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 8,050.05 亿元人民币） 。 从今年 12 月开始，Anthropic 每月支付的金额将达到约 31 亿美元 （现汇率约合 207.1 亿元人民币） 。不过，Anthropic 拥有在 2027 年初之后提前 90 天书面通知即可取消合同的权利。
items.summary_en: Bloomberg reports that Anthropic has become SpaceX's largest single customer, accounting for more than a third of its revenue last quarter. The mystery buyer labeled "Customer B" in SpaceX's filing — about 34.5% of revenue — is Anthropic, which leases compute at SpaceX's Memphis, Tennessee data center under a contract running to 2029 with a potential spending cap of $120.5 billion.
items.why_zh: 这笔交易显示 AI 算力需求正重塑科技公司的收入结构，也让 SpaceX 的营收高度依赖单一 AI 客户。
items.why_en: The deal shows AI compute demand reshaping tech revenue mixes and leaves SpaceX highly dependent on a single AI customer.

items.title_zh: 亚马逊 CEO 安迪 · 贾西自信放话：AWS 终将取得万亿美元年营收
items.title_en: Amazon CEO Jassy Says AWS Will Eventually Reach $1 Trillion in Annual Revenue
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，亚马逊 CEO 安迪 · 贾西认为，旗下云计算业务亚马逊云科技（AWS）的年营收有望突破 1 万亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 6.68 万亿元人民币） 。 在当地时间 29 日的季度财报电话会议上，他再次强调这一目标：“亚马逊正在打造前所未有的业务。历史上还 没有任何企业的年营收达到 1 万亿美元 。” 为此，亚马逊还需要大幅增加资本开支，建设足以支撑 AWS 快速增长的基础设施。“我们仍预计 2026 年的现金资本开支大概要 2,200 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1.47 万亿元人民币） ，其中大部分投向 AWS。2027 年的支出还会明显增加，而且我们对这些投资取得可观回报有明确预期。” 亚马逊今年大举投资 AI 基础设施，持续让投资者感到不安。财报电话会议上，华尔街分析师反复追问贾西， 为什么需要投入如此巨额的资金，有什么依据相信业务会持续增长，以及未来的利润率能达到什么水平 。 贾西回应称， 这些钱花得值得 ，因为亚马逊希望抓住 AI 带动全球云计算需求激增的历史性机遇。AWS 当季营收同比增长 39%，连续第六个季度保持增长势头。 贾西还预计，AWS 在 2027 年和 2028 年的营收增幅 都将达到 40% 。“AWS 的年化营收规模达到 1,840 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1.23 万亿元人民币） ，但增长空间依然巨大。我们持续创新，…
items.summary_en: On Amazon's earnings call, CEO Andy Jassy reiterated that AWS can eventually reach $1 trillion in annual revenue, with capex of roughly $220 billion expected in 2026 — mostly for AWS — and more in 2027. AWS revenue grew 39% year over year in the quarter, its sixth straight quarter of growth, reaching a $184 billion annualized run rate.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，10 月 29 日，智元正式推出预训练 / 后训练 / 部署后 实现全链路规模化学习的具身模型 —— GO-3 Preview。 该模型采用具身原生的 WRAM（World Reasoning Action Model）架构，将任务推理、未来预测与动作生成连接起来，让机器人理解指令、预测未来，并生成可执行的动作。 该模型已于近日登顶 RoboDojo、RoboTwin、RoboColiseum 三大行业权威评测榜单， 将于 2026 年底全面开源 。 IT之家附官方介绍如下： 基于 WRAM 架构，GO-3 Preview 从数据与模型两个维度共同推进 Scaling，让异构经验参与共同学习。数据维度解决“学什么、学得够不够广”：人类第一视角视频提供丰富的物体交互和任务过程，机器人轨迹则建立观测、动作与物理结果之间的联系。模型维度解决“如何承接和运用这些经验”：通过增强学习能力，把分散的经验组织起来，转化为可迁移的通用能力。 经过预训练，模型任务迁移与复杂技能适应能力更强，并在 Zero-Shot（零样本）与 Few-Shot（少样本）任务中得到检验。在家居、厨房、多机协作、灵巧操作场景里，不用额外微调，机器人就能直接完成陌生任务。 面对更复杂的任务，GO-3 Preview 可利用少量示范进一步学习，完成制作煎饼果子这样的长程精细任务。 乐高拼装…
items.summary_en: AgiBot released GO-3 Preview, an embodied model built on its WRAM (World Reasoning Action Model) architecture that links task reasoning, future prediction and action generation. It tops three robotics benchmarks, handles zero-shot and few-shot household, kitchen and dexterous tasks, and is slated for full open-sourcing by end-2026.
items.why_zh: 具身模型若能在零样本下泛化并开源，将大幅降低通用机器人落地门槛。
items.why_en: If embodied models can generalize zero-shot and be open-sourced, the barrier to deploying general-purpose robots drops sharply.

items.title_zh: Artificial Analysis发布Intelligence Index v5基准，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash开源模型编码能力登顶
items.title_en: Artificial Analysis Debuts Intelligence Index v5; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Tops Coding Ranking

items.title_zh: Mistral 开放万亿参数模型权重，主攻网络安全
items.title_en: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity
items.summary_zh: Mistral 发布了其万亿参数模型的权重，并将网络安全作为主要落地场景。公司表示，开放权重能让组织对自身网络防御拥有一定程度的控制权，这是闭源模型难以提供的。对安全团队来说，可本地部署和调优的模型意味着敏感数据与告警日志无需外传，也能按自身业务需求进行定制。
items.summary_en: Mistral says its new model can afford organizations a kind of control over its cyber defenses that closed models can't.
items.why_zh: 万亿级模型开放权重，把“可控性”变成了安全领域选型的核心卖点。
items.why_en: Open weights at trillion-parameter scale make controllability a central selling point for security buyers.

items.title_zh: 纽约州立法禁止聊天机器人对儿童实施“不安全”行为

items.why_en: State laws can become de facto national compliance standards, directly shaping how AI products are designed for minors.

items.title_zh: DiffuSpace 推出 Clover-35B-A3B-Preview 扩散语言模型，兼顾性能与速度
items.title_en: DiffuSpace releases Clover-35B-A3B-Preview diffusion language model, balancing performance and speed
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 29 日消息，人工智能实验室扩散智能 (DiffuSpace) 昨日发布了其 Clover（三叶草）系列模型家族的首个成员：Clover-35B-A3B-Preview，并以 Apache 许可开源。 Clover-35B-A3B-Preview 是一款采用 MoE 架构的扩散语言模型。与传统自回归模型不同的是，其具备“全局思维”，通过多轮迭代实现结果的从模糊到具体。 DiffuSpace 表示，Clover-35B-A3B-Preview 的诞生证明 扩散语言模型能在更大的参数尺度下与自回归模型竞争甚至略胜一筹 ， 同时保持更快生成速度 。 该模型在多项基准测试中性能超过同规模的自回归模型 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B，尤其擅长智能体编程与工具使用任务。 参考 https://diffuspace.ai/blog/clover-35b/
items.summary_en: DiffuSpace has released Clover-35B-A3B-Preview, the first member of its Clover family, under the Apache license. It is a MoE-based diffusion language model that uses iterative refinement rather than traditional autoregressive generation. DiffuSpace says it matches or slightly beats comparable autoregressive models while generating faster, and it outperforms Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on several benchmarks, especially agentic coding and tool use.
items.why_zh: 扩散语言模型在35B MoE尺度上开源，挑战自回归主流路线并提升生成速度。
items.why_en: An open-source 35B MoE diffusion language model challenges the dominant autoregressive approach while improving generation speed.

items.title_zh: Anthropic请华尔街相信AGI
items.title_en: Anthropic is asking Wall Street to believe in AGI
items.summary_zh: Decoder节目邀请芯片与AI研究机构SemiAnalysis分析师Joey Brookhart，解读Anthropic提交的S-1文件。Anthropic已在纳斯达克递交上市申请，最快下月开始交易，估值区间为1.5万亿至2万亿美元，若成真将立即跻身全球最有价值公司之列。节目指出，估值并非故事全部，数百页S-1中的数字与叙述更值得深挖，核心是让华尔街相信AGI叙事。
items.summary_en: Today on Decoder , I’m joined by Joey Brookhart, an analyst at the chip and AI research firm SemiAnalysis, to help me dig into the story inside the numbers of the Anthropic IPO filing — a document known as an S-1. Anthropic just filed its S-1 to go public on the Nasdaq, and it could start trading as soon as next month at a valuation of anywhere between $1.5 trillion and $2 trillion. That would immediately make it one of the most valuable companies on the planet. But the price tag really isn’t the whole story here. The S-1 document published earlier this week is hundreds upon hundreds of pages…

items.title_zh: 百度集团副总裁吴甜离职，知情人士称文心模型下周将有新进展
items.title_en: Baidu VP Wu Tian departs; Wenxin model expected to show new progress next week
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 29 日消息，针对百度集团副总裁、百度研究院副院长吴甜离职的传闻，百度公关经理在朋友圈作出回应，确认吴甜已结束在百度的任职。她表示，百度的技术工作仍在向前推进。 据接近百度的知情人士透露，文心模型方面下周将有新进展对外发布。IT之家此前报道，百度世界 2026 大会定于 11 月 12 日举行，官方信息显示大会将展示文心 Unlimited OCR 2 的技术亮点及应用潜力，并发布百度“芯云模体”全栈 AI 的最新升级成果。 公开资料显示，吴甜在百度工作约 20 年。她于 2006 年硕士毕业于浙江大学后加入百度，从技术研发岗位起步，是文心一言模型早期的主要技术负责人之一。 2025 年 11 月，百度成立基础模型研发部，吴甜出任负责人，直接向 CEO 李彦宏汇报。此后百度基础模型团队经历组织调整：今年 5 月，吴甜不再负责基础模型研发部门，转任百度研究院副院长；7 月，大模型领域技术专家孙天祥加入百度，接管基础模型研发部。 就在 10 月 27 日，百度发布并开源了文心 Unlimited OCR 2，将文档解析的处理上限从数十页扩展至任意页数。该模型在面向多页文档的 MPDocBench 和评估百页级超长文档的 MarathonDocBench 上综合得分分别为 84.6 分和 77.1 分，达到端到端性能 SOTA。其技术核心是稀疏参考滑动窗口注意力机制，…
items.summary_en: Baidu has confirmed that Vice President and Baidu Research Institute Deputy Director Wu Tian has left the company, according to IT Home. Sources close to Baidu say the Wenxin model will have new progress to announce next week. Wu spent about 20 years at Baidu and was one of the early key technical leads for Wenxin Yiyan; Baidu World 2026 is scheduled for Nov. 12 and will showcase Wenxin Unlimited OCR 2 and full-stack AI upgrades.
items.why_zh: 百度基础模型核心人事变动与文心新进展叠加，影响其大模型竞争节奏。
items.why_en: A key personnel change in Baidu's foundation-model team coincides with new Wenxin progress, affecting its LLM competitive momentum.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 的商业计划：要么造出机器之神，要么死在路上
items.title_en: Anthropic’s business plan: Build God or die trying
items.summary_zh: 有分析者从 Anthropic 提交的 S-1 文件中读出一层意味：这份文件为公司尽可能多地把钱砸进算力提供了财务上的正当理由。文章调侃说，如果你怀疑 Anthropic 一边全力造“机器之神”、一边又向华尔街证明自己只是在卖 IT 服务合同，那么这份 S-1 恰好给出了答案——做一堆看起来像在造机器之神的事，是避免破产的唯一办法。作者认为，暂时放下“机器之神”的想象，S-1 透露出的信息是 Anthropic 正在把公司的未来押在某个方向上。文章整体以评论口吻解读 Anthropic 的算力投入与商业模式之间的张力。
items.summary_en: The Anthropic S-1 seems to have provided the financial justification for the company to spend as much as it possibly can on compute. If you are the kind of person who wonders if Anthropic is doing its level best to build a machine god while convincing Wall Street it's in the business of selling IT contracts, Anthropic has just offered a handy solution: Doing a bunch of things that look like you're trying to build the machine god is the only way to avoid going bankrupt. Forget about the machine god for a minute. At least in my read of the S-1, it seems like Anthropic is pinning the future of it…
items.why_zh: S-1 文件揭示了顶级 AI 实验室如何用资本市场逻辑为巨额算力支出正名。
items.why_en: The S-1 offers a rare look at how a leading AI lab justifies massive compute spending to public markets.

items.title_zh: 今日宜休王腾：睡眠健康问题是困扰国民的关键问题，中国约 2.76 亿人睡眠质量不佳
items.title_en: ISHO's Wang Teng: About 276 Million Chinese Have Poor Sleep Quality, Aims to Build a Global AI Sleep Tech Ecosystem in 5-10 Years
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 29 日现场消息，在今晚的 ISHO 今日宜休 AI 睡眠科技生态产品发布会上，今日宜休科技公司创始人王腾登台主讲。 在正式发布产品前，王腾分享了一组全球和国内的睡眠健康数据。他直言：“睡眠健康问题是困扰国民的关键问题。”王腾分享的数据显示： 全球失眠人群约 8.52 亿，20 岁及以上，患病率 16.2%； 全球阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停人群约 9.36 亿，30-69 岁，AHI≥5 次/小时 ； 全球重度失眠人群约 4.15 亿，20 岁及以上，患病率 7.9%； 中国阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停人群约 1.76 亿，30-69 岁，AHI≥ 5 次/小时 ； 中国睡眠质量不佳约 2.76 亿人，15 岁及以上，PSQI＞5； 中国成年人睡眠困扰率 38.2%，18 岁及以上，包含易醒、早醒、入睡困难等。 IT之家从发布会现场获悉，王腾宣布，依托中国优秀的工程师资源和顶级的产业链能力， 目标用 5-10 年的时间打造全球领先的 AI 睡眠科技生态 。
items.summary_en: At ISHO's AI sleep technology ecosystem launch event, founder Wang Teng cited data showing about 852 million people worldwide suffer from insomnia and roughly 276 million Chinese aged 15 and above have poor sleep quality, with 38.2% of Chinese adults reporting sleep problems. He said the company aims to build a world-leading AI sleep tech ecosystem within 5-10 years.
items.why_zh: 睡眠健康正成为AI硬件与健康科技公司争夺的新场景，大规模人群数据为其产品叙事提供了市场基础。
items.why_en: Sleep health is emerging as a new battleground for AI hardware and health tech firms, and the large affected population underpins the market case for such products.

items.why_zh: 字节把竞争对手的模型接入自家企业平台，意味着国内大模型竞争正从模型本身转向企业分发渠道与生态入口。
items.why_en: By hosting rival vendors' models on its enterprise platform, ByteDance signals that China's LLM competition is shifting from the models themselves to enterprise distribution and ecosystem gateways.

items.title_zh: 豆包工作向企业客户推出第三方模型服务：含 Kimi 3.1 Pro、GLM 5.3、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 等
items.title_en: Doubao Work Opens Third-Party Models to Enterprises, Including Kimi 3.1 Pro, GLM 5.3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 29 日消息，豆包工作今日宣布向企业客户开放第三方模型服务， 首批将接入 Kimi 3.1 Pro、GLM 5.3、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 等系列模型 。 IT之家了解到，本次更新面向团队订阅版和企业订阅版客户开放，上线后默认直接开启。企业无需另行向模型厂商采购，也无需额外申请，后续按照用量扣除企业已有的 AI 点数。 同时，企业还可以按照成员、部门、群组或全员灵活划定可用范围，按模型厂商一键批量启用，或针对单一模型进行单独配置。
items.summary_en: Doubao Work announced that third-party models including Kimi 3.1 Pro, GLM 5.3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash are now available to enterprise customers. The feature is on by default for team and enterprise subscriptions, is billed against existing AI credits, and lets admins control availability by member, department, group or company-wide scope.
items.why_zh: 一次接入多家国产模型并默认开启，降低了企业的多模型选型成本，也加剧了企业AI入口的争夺。
items.why_en: Bundling multiple Chinese models and enabling them by default lowers the cost of multi-model adoption for enterprises, while intensifying the fight for the enterprise AI gateway.

items.summary_en: Jingsheng Mechanical & Electrical reported revenue of 5.414 billion yuan for the first three quarters of 2026, down 34.56%, and net profit of 283 million yuan, down 68.65%, with non-recurring-adjusted profit down 83.13% to 127 million yuan. Third-quarter net profit fell 80.82% to 50.26 million yuan, while operating cash flow jumped 352.3% to 1.718 billion yuan.
items.why_zh: 光伏设备龙头的营收与利润双双大幅下滑，折射出光伏行业扩产周期降温对上游设备商的传导效应。
items.why_en: The sharp fall in both revenue and profit at a leading photovoltaic equipment maker reflects how the cooling PV capacity expansion cycle is rippling upstream to equipment suppliers.
